title: CrebA regulation of secretory capacity: Genome-wide transcription profiling coupled with in vivo DNA binding studies
authors: D.J. Jackson; D. Peng; S.A. Shinde; A. Holenarasipura; P. Cahan; D.J. Andrew
one_liner_zh: 该文通过DNA结合实验和单细胞RNA测序研究果蝇CrebA转录因子对分泌途径基因的调控，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且未深入三维互作建模，仅部分涉及TF-DNA结合。
abstract: DNA binding assays, expression analyses, and binding site mutagenesis revealed that the Drosophila CrebA transcription factor (TF) boosts secretory capacity in the embryonic salivary gland (SG) through direct regulation of secretory pathway component genes (SPCGs). The mammalian orthologues of CrebA, the Creb3L-family of leucine zipper TFs, not only activate SPCG expression in a variety of mammalian tissues but can also activate SPCG expression in Drosophila embryos, suggesting a highly conserved role for this family of proteins in boosting secretory capacity. However, in vivo assays reveal that CrebA binds far more genes than it regulates, and it remains unclear what distinguishes functional binding. It is also unclear if CrebA is the major factor driving SPCG gene expression in all Drosophila embryonic tissues and/or if CrebA also regulates other tissue-specific functions. Thus, we did single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) of wild-type (WT) and CrebA null embryos to explore the relationship between CrebA binding and gene regulation. We find that CrebA binds the proximal promoters of its targets, that SPCGs are the major class of genes regulated by CrebA across tissues, and that CrebA is sufficient to activate SPCG expression even in cells that do not normally express the protein. A comparison of scRNA-Seq to other methods for capturing regulated transcripts reveals that the different methodologies identify overlapping but distinct sets of CrebA targets.
abstract_zh: DNA结合实验、表达分析及结合位点突变揭示，果蝇CrebA转录因子（TF）通过直接调控分泌途径组分基因（SPCGs）增强胚胎唾液腺（SG）的分泌能力。CrebA的哺乳动物同源物，即亮氨酸拉链转录因子Creb3L家族，不仅能在多种哺乳动物组织中激活SPCG表达，还能在果蝇胚胎中激活SPCG表达，表明该蛋白家族在增强分泌能力方面具有高度保守的作用。然而，体内实验显示，CrebA结合的基因远多于其调控的基因，且尚不清楚功能性结合的决定因素。此外，也不明确CrebA是否在所有果蝇胚胎组织中驱动SPCG基因表达的主要因子，以及CrebA是否还调控其他组织特异性功能。因此，我们对野生型（WT）和CrebA缺失胚胎进行了单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq），以探索CrebA结合与基因调控之间的关系。我们发现，CrebA结合其靶基因的近端启动子，SPCGs是CrebA在各组织中调控的主要基因类别，且CrebA足以在通常不表达该蛋白的细胞中激活SPCG表达。将scRNA-Seq与其他捕获调控转录本的方法进行比较，揭示不同方法识别出重叠但不同的CrebA靶基因集合。
